articles.headline: Gilgeous-Alexander's 42 points help Thunder to a 124-116 win over the Cavaliers
articles.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 42 points and eight assists and the Oklahoma City Thunder withstood a late rally and beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 124-116 on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Nembhard scores 22, Nesmith hits a late 3-pointer to lead Pacers past Grizzlies 107-103
articles.description: — Andrew Nembhard scored 22 points, Aaron Nesmith had 16, including a 3-pointer in the closing seconds, and the Indiana Pacers beat the Memphis Grizzles 107-103 on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Porter and Randle power the Nets to their 2nd win of the season, 114-104 over the Hornets
articles.description: — Michael Porter Jr. had 26 points and 10 rebounds and Julius Randle added 22 points as the Brooklyn Nets won their second game of the season, 114-104 over the Charlotte Hornets on Wednesday night.
